name: compare_card_text
title: Compare card text
description:
Diffs new wording against a card's live text, sentence by sentence, and saves nothing. Without
`card_id`, `field` is `persona.instructions` or `persona.guardrails`. `suggest_card_change` stores
wording for a card, for a person to accept.

card_id.description: From `read_flow`. Leave it out for the persona.

field.description: A text setting of the card, e.g. `instructions`. A refusal lists the card's.

new_text.description: The whole new text, at most 20,000 characters.
